description: A single-clinician rural centre roughly 90 minutes by road from the nearest tertiary hospital. Overrides only what genuinely differs from the reference protocol — everything else is inherited. Two things drive the changes: absolute volumes are far lower, so surge begins at a much smaller number; and there is no specialist on site to sanity-check an ambiguous case, so the assistant escalates on less uncertainty rather than more.

ruleOverrides.note: No non-invasive ventilation on site and a 90-minute transfer. Any hypoxia starts the transfer conversation immediately rather than being observed.
With one clinician and no monitoring bay, a patient with deranged observations cannot be safely left in a waiting area.
